shots.title: Define assignment, callback, and handoff lifecycle

hazards.description: [architect review] Callback obligations lacked durable identity across repeated execution spells.
[architect review] Handoff transitions violated immutable assignment revision and acceptance rules.
[architect review] Compound workflow operations contradicted the one-primary-event append model.
[architect review] Compound foreign-aggregate mutations lacked affected aggregate chain positions.
[architect review] Idempotency was principal-scoped and omitted the required round_epoch.
[architect review] Callback recovery registry used inconsistent event versions and transitions.
[architect review] Version 2 chain-link and event hashing was circular and non-deterministic.
[architect review] Version 2 authorization sets could disagree with the S264.1 singular authorization.
[security review] Callback completion was not unique per execution obligation.
[security review] Callback delivery idempotency did not include recipient and destination.
[security review] Compound transitions contradicted the one-event integrity model.
[security review] Assignment restart and recovery path was undefined.
[security review] Idempotency identity was principal-scoped rather than conflict-checked.
[security review] Assignment compound transitions were missing from the strict transition registry.
[security review] Version 2 per-aggregate hash construction was self-referential.
[security review] Authorization sets lacked replayable one-to-one transition binding.

shots.notes: Defined immutable assignment revisions, execution spells, exactly-once callback dispositions, atomic handoff, recovery, and compound-event integrity.

shots.title: Define independent verification workflow

hazards.description: [architect review] Verification lifecycle referenced undeclared states and allowed terminal reversal.
[architect review] Contribution provenance could fail open when contributors were omitted.
[architect review] Quorum reducer lacked readiness and deterministic no-op behavior.
[architect review] Verification timeout recovery had no legal terminal disposition path.
[architect review] Verification timeout escalation lacked an enforceable terminal lifecycle.
[security review] Late contribution mutation could race an existing approval.
[security review] Verifier independence lacked hostile conflict and bypass tests.
[security review] Verifier slot decisions could directly approve an epoch without quorum reduction.
[security review] Unchanged-byte rejection had no independently authorized appeal path.
[security review] Quorum reducer could enter dispute before all required slots were ready.
[security review] A timed-out verification epoch could receive multiple different-key semantic dispositions.

shots.notes: Defined producer-proven contribution closure, verifier slots, quorum reduction, appeals, waivers, invalidation, timeout disposition, and terminal escalation.

shots.title: Define merge-safe learning and semantic status

hazards.description: [architect review] Pattern merge and split lacked concurrency-safe atomic semantics.
[architect review] Status precedence was not total and omitted worker aggregation.
[architect review] Worker aggregation mishandled complete_unverified and verification terminal states.
[security review] Pattern merge and split did not preserve integrity under concurrency.
[security review] Learning recurrence could be inflated by duplicate evidence wrappers.
[security review] Status health could report healthy from an incomplete signal set.
[security review] Filtered status views could compute misleading coverage and health.
[security review] Learning report acceptance still required a hidden event batch.
[security review] Historical completion could hide newer active work in status precedence.

shots.notes: Defined stable occurrence identity, atomic learning acceptance and topology changes, total status precedence, safe health, and filtered operating views.

shots.title: Define multiplayer evaluation contract

hazards.description: [architect review] Evaluation lifecycle and authorization contract was incomplete.
[architect review] Evaluation replay and report identity were undefined.
[architect review] Phase 64 did not assign all runtime ownership.
[architect review] Evaluation idempotency incorrectly scoped identity by aggregate version.
[architect review] Evidence terminal states and capability boundaries were incomplete.
[architect review] Report lifecycle omitted explicit capability ownership.
[architect review] Failed, timed-out, and cancelled attempts could not reconcile for collection closure.
[architect review] Campaign invalidation lacked a complete analysis and report transition registry.
[architect review] Trial failure and timeout allowed no-current-attempt gaps.
[security review] Collection could close while unfavorable trials remained live.
[security review] Trial reuse lacked deterministic compatibility constraints.
[security review] Corpus selection permitted post-hoc cherry-picking.
[security review] Campaign learning could contaminate treatment during collection.
[security review] Arm budget accounting omitted coordination and retry boundaries.
[security review] Analysis reproducibility did not pin executable and numeric semantics.
[security review] Evaluation idempotency incorrectly included aggregate version in identity.
[security review] Evidence lifecycle had no complete terminal disposition path.
[security review] Evidence verification timeout had no recovery-authorized terminal path.
[security review] Trial and attempt terminal evidence states could diverge.
[security review] Retry atomicity granted successor allocation authority to a failure-only principal.

shots.notes: Defined sealed sampling and corpus selection, complete campaign and trial census, atomic attempt reconciliation, aggregate budgets, reproducible analysis, and independently verified reports.

conditions.description: The contract governs multi-principal authority, concurrency, privacy, deterministic replay, and causal evaluation across the full Team Round workflow.

training.description: Collaboration correctness requires durable obligations, independent authority, one-event compound transitions, complete terminal accounting, and replayable evidence.
training.outcome: The contract now gives S268-S272 explicit state machines, authorization boundaries, integrity formulas, and adversarial acceptance tests.

nutrition.description: 259 test files passed; 4,324 tests passed and 27 were skipped. The complete gate is rerun on the final PR head.
TypeScript typecheck and the root plus pi-extension production build passed on Node 22.
All 56 independent review findings are recorded as resolved; architecture and security reviewers approved exact contract commit 3c5073c.

bunker_locations: Keep callback identity tied to execution spells and close every obligation with one disposition.
Treat compound events as one append with cycle-free per-aggregate integrity and replayable authorization.
Require producer-proven contribution closure and principal-level verifier independence.
Seal evaluation sampling, budgets, terminal census, analysis semantics, and report verification before execution.
yardage_book_updates: Separate assignment work, verification epoch, verifier slot, timeout disposition, and escalation aggregates.
Compute safe health from the complete authoritative signal set before filtering.
Use stable learning occurrence identity and one-event merge, split, and report acceptance.
Split failure classification from retry allocation even when the retry transition is atomic.
